answer.explanation: TicketController in the presentation layer imports and is constructor-injected with TicketRepository from the persistence layer. Its close method calls repo.close directly. That skips the business layer (TicketService), so any business logic for closing a ticket is bypassed and state is changed straight from the presentation layer. FF-S03 flags this layer-skipping dependency. The only nearby comment is "TODO: tidy this up later", which states no rule and grants no exception. No doc or ADR declares anything on this, so the ranking rests on what the dependency does: a layer is bypassed to change state.
